defects.required_behavior: Declining a code change does not remove a concrete author's response obligation.
Complete applicable feedback replies before independent review can block finalization.
Pending user/team reviews, including renewed requests after same-head approval, hold merge.
Conclusive pending-review rejection can settle as not_applied; preserve drafts and ambiguous effects.
Require real coordinator/child execution evidence, never report-only substitutes.
Allow pinned provisional private analysis during metadata disagreement; withhold external readiness.
Recover current-head alignment without requiring a historical rejection receipt.
Refresh uncertain alignment with new requirements without repeating settled comparisons.
Publish unanchorable verified metadata findings in the review body even with summaries disabled.
